what: Degraded-round cap ownership is ambiguous and likely double-counted in loop mode
scenario_or_breakage: run-step5-review.sh currently inflates ROUND_CAP before calling review-and-fix.sh, while the planned loop also adds count_prior_degraded_rounds; a resumed loop after degraded rounds can get extra review rounds
suggested_fix: Make loop mode pass the base cap only and let review-and-fix.sh own degraded inflation; keep the existing inflated cap only for single-round mode and add a degraded resume test

what: Main-agent-vote accepted fixes use findings mode, which does not commit in implement context
scenario_or_breakage: After main-agent adjudication, accepted fixes can remain uncommitted before the wrapper resumes, breaking per-round review assumptions and post-coder-head/substantiality accounting
suggested_fix: Add an implement-mode MAV apply path that accepts the adjudicated findings plus round number and performs the same commit/artifact contract as an ordinary review round

what: Substantiality diff lacks an explicit per-round pre-coder HEAD snapshot
scenario_or_breakage: Using the run-root pre-review head or a missing pre-coder file makes round 2+ structural_loc include prior fixes or collapse to zero, so the loop may continue or stop incorrectly
suggested_fix: Write round-N/pre-coder-head.txt immediately before coder dispatch for every round, write post-coder-head.txt after a successful commit, and diff that exact pair

what: Relevant-checks failure handling omits no-log FAILURE_REASON cases
scenario_or_breakage: log-dir-create-failed, log-dir-symlink-rejected, log-file-chmod-failed, log-allocation, and attempt-cap failures emit STATUS=fail without REDACTED_LOG_FILE but are not in the structural list, leaving the planned loop with no defined branch
suggested_fix: Treat any STATUS=fail with no REDACTED_LOG_FILE as a stall with STALL_REASON=relevant-checks-${FAILURE_REASON:-unknown}; keep specific reasons only for categorization

what: Post-check lint-fix loop has no attempt budget
scenario_or_breakage: If lint-fix-loop repeatedly returns applied while checks still fail, the Bash wrapper can keep dispatching external coders indefinitely inside one Step 5 call
suggested_fix: Add a per-round max attempts guard, for example LARCH_STEP5_LINT_FIX_MAX_ATTEMPTS defaulting to 3, then stall with a distinct reason when exhausted

what: The test plan relies on stubbing a private Bash function without a source-safe entry point
scenario_or_breakage: The script currently executes at top level when IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR is set, so tests cannot cleanly source it and override _implement_round_body without changing the script architecture
suggested_fix: Use public CLI tests with dependency stubs, or explicitly refactor to a guarded main "$@" entry point plus a documented test hook before planning private function stubs
